mechanism: Ginseng may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing voriconazole plasma concentrations, while voriconazole is a potent inhibitor of CYP3A4 and CYP2C19 that may increase ginseng metabolite accumulation.
action: Monitor for voriconazole toxicity signs (visual disturbances, hepatotoxicity); consider therapeutic drug monitoring of voriconazole levels and assess ginseng necessity during antifungal therapy.
